title: ?, +, | and _
intro: Keys this course has not used yet: ?, +, | and _. Each of them is Shift plus a key your fingers already know — Shift with the little finger of the other hand.
congrats: ?, +, | and _: under your fingers now. Shift with the other hand, and a symbol comes as easily as the letter beside it.
